# DFWin International

> DFWin International sources, engineers and ships hotel equipment, tableware, RFID and marine products for cruise lines, shipyards and hotels. Supplying the cruise industry since 2014.

Key facts, all taken from the company's own published information:

- Legal name: Hong Kong DFWin Int'l Co. Limited
- Founded: 2012
- Offices: Hong Kong (Head office), Hialeah, Florida (United States office)
- Supplying cruise lines since: 2014
- Stainless steel luggage cages delivered for Quantum of the Seas: 352
- SOLAS approved life jackets supplied in a single order: 2,000
- Royal Caribbean International ships fitted with our turbocharger filters: 21
- Catalog: 58 products across Technology, Hospitality, Marine
- Prices are not published. Buyers request a quote and get a reply within one business day.
- Sales contact: braydai@dfwin-intl.com. General contact: info@dfwin-intl.com

Product IDs look like HOSP-0017, MARI-0004 or TECH-0001. Quote them when asking for a price.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://sarah-sami-ai-studios.github.io/DFWIN-next/): What DFWin supplies and who it supplies.
- [Product catalog](https://sarah-sami-ai-studios.github.io/DFWIN-next/catalog.html): All 58 products with search and filters. Search by adding ?q=term to the address.
- [Request a quote](https://sarah-sami-ai-studios.github.io/DFWIN-next/quote.html): Send a list of products and quantities to the sales team.
- [Services](https://sarah-sami-ai-studios.github.io/DFWIN-next/services.html): Sourcing, engineering and delivery services.
- [Track record](https://sarah-sami-ai-studios.github.io/DFWIN-next/track-record.html): Dated contracts, supplier registrations and events.
- [About](https://sarah-sami-ai-studios.github.io/DFWIN-next/about.html): Company background and offices.

## Product categories

- [Technology](https://sarah-sami-ai-studios.github.io/DFWIN-next/catalog.html#technology): RFID wristbands, key cards and fobs for access, payment and guest identification. Categories: RFID Wristbands, Key Cards, Key Fobs.
- [Hospitality](https://sarah-sami-ai-studios.github.io/DFWIN-next/catalog.html#hospitality): Carts, trolleys, linens, tableware and in-room equipment for hotels, resorts and cruise ship hotel operations. Categories: Carts, Melamine Dinnerware, Trash Bins, Drinkware, Trolleys, Towels & Linens, Stanchions & Barriers, Hotel Safes, Lighting, Chinaware, Flatware, Hair Dryers, Refrigeration.
- [Marine](https://sarah-sami-ai-studios.github.io/DFWIN-next/catalog.html#marine): Mooring ropes, life jackets and deck lighting for ship operators and yards. Categories: Mooring Ropes, Life Jackets & Safety, Marine Lighting.

## How to request a quote

- [Quote request form](https://sarah-sami-ai-studios.github.io/DFWIN-next/quote.html): List the product IDs and quantities you need. The sales team replies within one business day.
- [Email the sales team](mailto:braydai@dfwin-intl.com): Send product IDs, quantities and the delivery port or address.

## Contact

- [Sales](mailto:braydai@dfwin-intl.com): Quotes and product questions.
- [General enquiries](mailto:info@dfwin-intl.com): Everything else.
